note.en: The rendered HTML matches, but the token stream differs at `[0].content`: current `" a \n"`, reference `"a \n"`.
note.zh: 渲染后的 HTML 一致，但 token 流在 `[0].content` 处不同：当前包为 `" a \n"`，参考包为 `"a \n"`。

cases.name: word-boundary-close

note.en: The current fork requires a non-word character after the closing `$`, so `$a$b` stays literal text and nothing is rendered; the reference parses and renders `a`.
note.zh: 当前 fork 要求结尾 `$` 后为非单词字符，因此 `$a$b` 保持字面文本，不渲染任何内容；参考包会解析并渲染 `a`。

cases.referenceHtml: aaab

cases.name: word-boundary-open

note.en: The current fork requires a non-word character before the opening `$`, so `a$x$` stays literal text; the reference parses and renders `x`.
note.zh: 当前 fork 要求开头 `$` 前为非单词字符，因此 `a$x$` 保持字面文本；参考包会解析并渲染 `x`。

cases.referenceHtml: axxx

cases.name: adjacent-dollar-inline

note.en: The current fork never closes a formula when the closing `$` is immediately followed by another `$`, so the line stays literal; the reference renders `$a$` and `$b$` as two formulas.
note.zh: 当结尾 `$` 紧跟另一个 `$` 时，当前 fork 不会闭合公式，因此整行保持字面量；参考包会把 `$a$` 和 `$b$` 渲染为两个公式。

cases.referenceHtml: aaabbb

cases.name: literal-gap-inline

note.en: The current fork treats a space-surrounded `$` inside a formula as literal content and keeps scanning for the closing delimiter, then renders the formula; the reference gives up at the first `$` that cannot close and emits literal text.
note.zh: 当前 fork 将公式内部被空白包围的 `$` 视为字面内容并继续查找结束定界符，随后渲染该公式；参考包在第一个无法闭合的 `$` 处放弃，输出字面文本。

cases.ourHtml: \text{a $ b}

cases.name: block-trailing-content

note.en: A single-line `$$...$$` followed by non-whitespace content is deliberately not treated as a block by the current fork (the line stays a paragraph); the reference renders the whole line as one display formula and KaTeX reports an error for the trailing text.
note.zh: 单行 `$$...$$` 后跟非空白内容时，当前 fork 有意不将其视为块（整行保持为段落）；参考包会把整行渲染为一个显示公式，KaTeX 会因尾部文本报错。

cases.referenceHtml: a$$ tail

cases.name: macro-scope

note.en: Macros defined with the `gdef` command are shared between the formulas of one document by the current package, so the second formula renders `x`; the reference creates fresh KaTeX settings per formula, so the macro is undefined there and renders as a KaTeX error.
note.zh: 由 `gdef` 命令定义的宏在当前包中于同一文档的各个公式间共享，因此第二个公式渲染出 `x`；参考包为每个公式创建新的 KaTeX 设置，宏在那里未定义，会渲染为 KaTeX 错误。

cases.referenceHtml: \gdef\foo{x} \foo\foo\foo

notes.en: This comparison renders real KaTeX on both sides and compares the resulting HTML. The reference declares `katex: ^0.6.0`, but the committed workspace override (`pnpm-workspace.yaml`: `overrides.katex: ^0.19.0`, kept for the docs toolchain) makes the installed reference use the same KaTeX 0.19.1 as this package, so the rendered math HTML is directly comparable. If that override is ever removed the reference would fall back to KaTeX 0.6 and this spec would have to switch to a token-level comparison.
notes.zh: 本次对比会让双方都实际渲染 KaTeX，并比较生成的 HTML。参考包声明 `katex: ^0.6.0`，但仓库已提交的 workspace override（`pnpm-workspace.yaml` 中的 `overrides.katex: ^0.19.0`，为文档工具链保留）让已安装的参考包使用与本包相同的 KaTeX 0.19.1，因此渲染出的数学 HTML 可以直接比较。如果该 override 被移除，参考包会回退到 KaTeX 0.6，本 spec 就必须改为 token 级对比。

notes.en: The benchmark still shows a small gap that is not plugin overhead: this ESM package resolves `katex` through the `import` condition (`dist/katex.mjs`) while the CJS reference resolves `dist/katex.js`. The identical KaTeX 0.19.1 code runs about 4.5% faster as CJS on Node, so with both sides forced onto the same KaTeX build the packages measure at parity; neither package allocates KaTeX options per formula any more.
notes.zh: 基准测试仍显示一个小差距，但它不是插件开销：本 ESM 包通过 `import` 条件解析 `katex`（`dist/katex.mjs`），而 CJS 参考包解析到 `dist/katex.js`。完全相同的 KaTeX 0.19.1 代码在 Node 上以 CJS 运行时快约 4.5%，因此把双方强制到同一个 KaTeX 构建后，两个包测得的结果基本持平；两个包都不再为每个公式分配 KaTeX 选项。

notes.en: `@mdit/plugin-katex-slim` is the same tex + KaTeX composition as `@mdit/plugin-katex`; the only difference is that it loads KaTeX with a dynamic `import("katex")` at module initialization and throws when KaTeX is not installed. The comparison therefore uses the same cases and the results should match `plugin-katex`.
notes.zh: `@mdit/plugin-katex-slim` 与 `@mdit/plugin-katex` 是相同的 tex + KaTeX 组合；唯一区别是它在模块初始化时通过动态 `import("katex")` 加载 KaTeX，并在未安装 KaTeX 时抛错。因此对比使用相同的用例，结果应与 `plugin-katex` 一致。

notes.en:
Two intentional markup differences are normalized instead of compared: the current package wraps display math in `

` (the reference emits a plain `

`), and it keeps the edge whitespace/newline of the block formula while the reference trims it (the MathML `annotation` echoes the input formula, so its edge whitespace differs). The visible KaTeX HTML is unchanged by either normalization, and both are documented here rather than hidden.
notes.zh:
两处有意的标记差异采用归一化而不是直接比较：当前包把显示公式包在 `

` 中（参考包输出普通 `

`），并保留块公式首尾的空白与换行，而参考包会将其裁剪（MathML 的 `annotation` 会回显输入公式，因此其首尾空白不同）。两种归一化都不改变可见的 KaTeX HTML，而且都在此记录而非隐藏。

notes.en: `throwOnError: false` is set on both sides so that invalid LaTeX is handled the same way. This is already the default of the current package; with the reference's defaults the reference instead emits the raw LaTeX from its own `catch` block, which is a documented default difference and not compared.
notes.zh: 双方都设置 `throwOnError: false`，以便以相同方式处理非法 LaTeX。这已经是当前包的默认值；在参考包的默认配置下，参考包会改为从自己的 `catch` 块输出原始 LaTeX，这是已记录的默认值差异，不参与比较。

notes.en: Documented differences, inherited from the current fork's stricter delimiter rules: opening `$` needs a non-word character before it and closing `$` needs a non-word character after it (`$a$b`, `a$x$`), an inline `$` surrounded by whitespace inside a formula is treated as literal and scanning continues (`$\text{a $ b}$`), a closing `$` may not be immediately followed by another `$` (`$a$$b$`), and a single-line `$$...$$` followed by inline content is not a block (`$$a$$ tail`).
notes.zh: 已记录差异，源自当前 fork 更严格的定界符规则：开头的 `$` 前需要非单词字符，结尾的 `$` 后需要非单词字符（`$a$b`、`a$x$`），公式内部被空白包围的行内 `$` 被视为字面量并继续扫描（`$\text{a $ b}$`），结尾 `$` 不能紧跟另一个 `$`（`$a$$b$`），且单行 `$$...$$` 后跟行内内容时不视为块（`$$a$$ tail`）。

notes.en: One difference is a feature, not a regression: macros defined with `\gdef` are shared between the formulas of one document by the current package (`macros` is a single object per render), while the reference creates fresh KaTeX settings for every formula, so a later formula cannot use an earlier `\gdef`. The case documents this.
notes.zh: 有一处差异是特性而非回归：当前包中由 `\gdef` 定义的宏在同一次文档渲染的各个公式间共享（每次渲染只有一个 `macros` 对象），而参考包为每个公式创建全新的 KaTeX 设置，因此后面的公式无法使用前面 `\gdef` 定义的宏。该用例记录了这一点。

notes.en: Fork-only behavior is not compared because the reference has no equivalent option: bracket delimiters (`\(...\)` / `\[...\]`), `mathFence` (```` ```math ````), `allowInlineWithSpace`, `transformer`, and the `logger` callback.
notes.zh: 参考包没有等价选项的 fork 专有行为不参与比较：方括号定界符（`\(...\)` / `\[...\]`）、`mathFence`（```` ```math ````）、`allowInlineWithSpace`、`transformer` 以及 `logger` 回调。

notes.en: Benchmarks render real KaTeX on both sides with small corpora: 24 inline formulas for `normal/large`, and 24 inline plus 8 display formulas for `heavy/large`. Per-case `targetMs` is 100 ms.
notes.zh: 基准测试会让双方实际渲染 KaTeX，语料较小：`normal/large` 有 24 个行内公式，`heavy/large` 有 24 个行内公式加 8 个显示公式。每个用例的 `targetMs` 为 100 ms。

notes.en: Scaling series measure real rendering: many inline formulas, one very long formula, and many display formulas. KaTeX 0.19 rendering and the reference parser were both measured as linear (~1) on every pattern probed, so these series are a regression baseline rather than an exposure of superlinear behavior.
notes.zh: 伸缩序列测量实际渲染：大量行内公式、一个超长公式以及大量显示公式。KaTeX 0.19 渲染与参考包解析器在探测到的每种模式上均测得为线性（约 1），因此这些序列是回归基线，而不是用来暴露超线性行为。
